scripts.text:
[Yakima]
{0}
I can make some items for you.
They are quite rare nowadays...
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
{0}
我可以为你制作一些物品。
这些物品如今可是相当稀有……

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Oh.. it's an excellent item for any beast hunter.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
哦……这对任何野兽猎人来说都是件极好的装备。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
For the hat I'll need:
1 Sombrero,
920 Feathers of Birds and
310 Bills of Birds.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
制作这顶帽子我需要：
1个阔边帽，
920根鸟羽毛和
310个鸟喙。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Do you have all the items?
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
你带齐所有材料了吗？

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Bingo! Many people are afraid of lions... to the muteness...
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
太棒了！很多人都害怕狮子……怕得说不出话来……

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
For the hat I'll need:
1 Tiger Mask,
10 Tiger's Footskins,
30 Tiger Skins and
300 Tiger Panties.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
制作这顶帽子我需要：
1个老虎面具，
10张虎掌，
30张虎皮和
300条老虎内裤。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Do you have all the items?
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
你带齐所有材料了吗？

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
I wish I sold this filthy manteau faster...
Guess it isn't so plain as it looks... Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
我真希望这件脏兮兮的斗篷能快点卖出去……
看来它并不像外表看起来那么普通……嗯。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
I'm giving it almost for free:
10 Old Manteaus,
3 Skull Rings,
2 Manteau[1] and
1 Ragamuffin Manteau.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
我几乎是白送给你了：
10件旧斗篷，
3枚骷髅戒指，
2件斗篷[1]和
1件抗魔斗篷。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Do you have all the items?
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
你带齐所有材料了吗？

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
It's a fresh style! Accessory and a bag all in one! You'd get +2 STR... It's different from that sabby nest!
It fits to Merchant class only.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
这是最新潮的风格！配饰和包包合二为一！还能获得力量+2……这和那个俗气的鸟窝可不一样！
只有商人职业才能装备。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Now my stock is full of those bags... So I'll make it from 3 flower things and a rough piece of clothes:
3 Romantic Flowers,
3 Fancy Flowers,
2 Flower Rings and
3 Pirate Bandanas.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
现在我的库存里堆满了这种包包……所以我用3种花朵饰品和一块粗糙的布料来制作它：
3朵花叶，
3个花朵头饰，
2枚花戒指和
3条海盗头巾。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Do you have all the items?
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
你带齐所有材料了吗？

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Well, well, well... this sign fits any class from a certain level!
Your foes'd be dazzled!
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
呵呵呵……这个标志适合达到一定等级的所有职业！
你的敌人会被它晃得眼花缭乱！

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Well... we construct it from some common items:
1 Scarlet Dyestuffs,
1 Orange Dyestuffs,
2 Stop Posts,
3 Clown Noses,
180 Fig Leaves and
20 Solid Peaches.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
嗯……我们用一些常见的材料来制作它：
1瓶红色染料，
1瓶赤色染料，
2个停止标志头饰，
3个小丑鼻子，
180片无花果叶子和
20个坚实桃子。

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
Do you have all the items?
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
你带齐所有材料了吗？

scripts.text:
[Yakima]
You are lack of items. Please, get all the items.
scripts.translation:
[雅基马]
你的材料不足。请集齐所有材料。
